title: AuditEvent
description: One persisted line of the usertrust hash-chained audit log ('<vault>/.usertrust/audit/events.jsonl' plus rotated '*.jsonl' segments). Each line is one event serialized as canonical JSON: object keys sorted alphabetically at every nesting level, undefined stripped, null preserved, array order kept. The event's hash is the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON with the 'hash' field removed; 'previousHash' links to the prior event's hash, and the first event in a vault chains from the genesis hash (64 zeros). Unknown fields are permitted: any extra field is part of the hash pre-image, so verifiers hash the full line minus 'hash' rather than a fixed field list.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was appended.

previousHash.description: SHA-256 hash (hex) of the previous event in the chain. The first event in a vault uses the genesis hash: 64 zeros.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash (hex) of this event's canonical JSON with the 'hash' field removed. Recompute it to verify the line; any edit to any field changes it.

kind.description: Event kind. Open-ended; kinds emitted today include 'llm_call', 'stream_partial_delivery', 'anomaly_detected', and 'settlement_ambiguous'.

actor.description: Actor identity that produced the event (defaults to 'local').

data.description: Event payload. Open-ended by design: each kind carries its own fields, and all of them are covered by the hash.

sequence.description: 1-based global sequence number, continuous across rotated segments. Gaps indicate segment or event deletion. Legacy segments written before sequence numbering omit this field; the verifier accepts them, but every line the current writer persists includes it.
